body:
Blocked by: DengZhiyuan-math/proof-cli#198

## What

`proof reference edit <id> … --reason …` (audit section 2): fix a citation's bibliography in place.

- Reuse `ReferenceRecord`, `store_reference` and events. Keep `id`, `created_by` and `created_at`.
- Partial update: a field not given keeps its value.
- Editable: title, authors, year, URL, notes, typed metadata (`identifier`, `source_type`).
- Each edit is an event: editor, reason, old and new values.
- An Imported result's statement, `source_locator`, `source_version` and `reference_id` are not editable here; they stay the mathematical interface (ADR-0005). Citing another work or version is a new Imported result.
- Under ADR-0022, an edit gives an agent's import no trust. A researcher's import may meet or stop meeting a rule after an edit, as under ADR-0014.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Partial edits keep other fields; the event records the old and new values and the reason.
- [ ] Editing a field of the mathematical interface is refused with an error code.
- [ ] A test covers a researcher's import that meets a DOI rule once its identifier is added.

---

title: proof reference edit: fix a citation's bibliography in place, with a reason
